sloka: तं समुत्पत्य चिक्षेप कुम्भकर्णस्य वानरः।तमप्राप्तो महाकायं तस्य सैन्ये ऽपतत्तदा ।। ६.६७.१० ।।
transliteration: taṁ samutpatya cikṣepa kumbhakarṇasya vānaraḥ।tamaprāpto mahākāyaṁ tasya sainye 'patattadā ।। 6.67.10 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Dwivida, a bull among the Vanaras lifted a mountain and went towards Kumbhakarna who resembled a threatening cloud.
